mapper.select: SELECT client_id, party_id, status FROM t_client WHERE client_id = #{clientId} ORDER BY client_id
mapper.update: UPDATE t_client SET status='ACTIVE', update_time=#{now} WHERE client_id=#{clientId} AND status='PENDING'
mapper.sql: (SELECT NULLIF(COALESCE(o.legal_name, TRIM(CONCAT_WS(' ', i.given_name, i.middle_name, i.family_name))), '') FROM t_party_profile pp LEFT JOIN t_organization_profile o ON o.profile_id = pp.profile_id LEFT JOIN t_individual_profile i ON i.profile_id = pp.profile_id WHERE pp.party_id = ${partyColumn})
mapper.select: SELECT c.client_id AS clientId, c.client_no AS clientNo, c.party_id AS partyId, pt.party_type AS clientType, c.status AS status, AS legalName FROM t_client c JOIN t_party pt ON pt.party_id = c.party_id WHERE c.client_id = #{clientId}
